detection.rule: rear_end / lane_change: event while TTC <= 1.5 s for >= 0.3 s; crossing: PET <= 5.0 s over the shared swept-footprint zone
detection.citation: FHWA SSAM default (Gettman et al. 2008, FHWA-HRT-08-051; SSAM User Manual FHWA-HRT-08-050)

severity_ttc.rule: TTC_min <= 0.5 s critical; 0.5 < TTC_min <= 1.0 s serious; 1.0 < TTC_min <= 1.5 s moderate
severity_ttc.note: study-specific bins within the SSAM TTC <= 1.5 s detection range

severity_pet.rule: PET <= 1 s critical; 1 < PET <= 2.5 s serious; 2.5 < PET <= 5 s moderate
severity_pet.note: study-specific bins (no FHWA/SSAM standard for PET severity)

drac.rule: drac_flag = DRAC_max >= 3.4 m/s^2 (11.2 ft/s^2); reported alongside TTC events, not a detection criterion
drac.citation: AASHTO (2018) A Policy on Geometric Design of Highways and Streets, 7th ed.

ttc.rule: TTC = gap / (v_f - v_l) when v_f > v_l; gap = front-to-rear spacing (m); follower speed >= 2 m/s, gap >= 1 m, closing rate consistent with spacing change

pet.rule: footprint = length x width rectangle behind the front-bumper point, heading from velocity; conflict zone = intersection of the two swept footprints (0.5 m raster, 50 Hz); PET = t(second vehicle front enters zone) - t(first vehicle rear leaves zone); crossing only for conflicting approaches with conflict angle >= 30 deg
pet.citation: Allen et al. (1978) TRR 667; FHWA SSAM (Gettman et al. 2008)

overlap.rule: both footprints inside the shared zone at the same time -> recorded with pet = 0 and overlap = true
overlap.note: a physical overlap at NGSIM position accuracy is most likely a data error (Punzo et al. 2011), not an observed near-collision

citations: Gettman, D., Pu, L., Sayed, T., Shelby, S. (2008). Surrogate Safety Assessment Model and Validation: Final Report. FHWA-HRT-08-051; SSAM User Manual FHWA-HRT-08-050. Federal Highway Administration.
AASHTO (2018) A Policy on Geometric Design of Highways and Streets, 7th ed.
Allen, B. L., Shin, B. T., Cooper, P. J. (1978). Analysis of traffic conflicts and collisions. Transportation Research Record 667, 67-74.

Punzo, V., Borzacchiello, M. T., Ciuffo, B. (2011). On the assessment of vehicle trajectory data accuracy and application to the Next Generation SIMulation (NGSIM) program data. Transportation Research Part C 19(6), 1243-1262.

sensitivity.note: counts of distinct events at each threshold; TTC events from the same pair series, PET from one footprint pass (min PET per pair)

scatter_note: every TTC event detected at TTC <= 3.0 s; severity null above the 1.5 s detection threshold
